name: X-AnyLabeling Annotation
description:
Native Qt image annotation workspace inspired by X-AnyLabeling, running fully local.

Annotation editing: polygon, rectangle, rotation, quadrilateral, circle, line, point, line strip and cuboid shapes with live measurements; brush paint/erase with per-class targets; magic-wand region selection; group/ungroup and rectangle/polygon union; object rename, lock and visibility; undo/redo; label-only Save As and confirmed label deletion.

Compatibility: X-AnyLabeling JSON sidecars round-trip unchanged (unknown fields preserved); masks, labels, scores, degrees, attributes, linking and groups follow the upstream visualization toggles and exclusive display modes; session settings and shortcuts persist between runs.

AICore assistance: AI Describe runs a local vision model from the public llm catalog, and the model panel exposes shared AICore tasks (DA3, DeepLSD, ALIKED, YOLO, RF-DETR, SAM3, RMBG, face landmarks, RAM/Tag2Text, OCR) with models downloaded and verified through the shared AICore catalog/cache.
